audit.why: Thresh's Death Sentence (Q, 19/16.5/14/11.5/9s CD) gives him kill pressure from level 2 that Renata's kit cannot fully answer until items; teamfight phases favor Renata via Hostile Takeover flipping his single-target pick pattern.
Renata's power spikes are level 1 (E-poke), first item flip potential, and 2+ items where R out-ranges the hook; Thresh spikes at level 2 with lantern-assisted Q-Flay and again at 6 with The Box.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart used the placeholder side 'Skill' on all 7 rows while the content layer (win[]) already names Renata/Thresh per row for this matchup, and the missing-interactions data (Thresh's Dark Passage W shield absorbing Renata's burst) is not reflected anywhere in Key Ability Interactions.
audit.why: phases[N].side must agree with content win[N] for the same row (THE CHART RULE) and the shield-absorbs-burst interaction is a genuine, kit-grounded fact this matchup should state.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[].side values to match the already-correct win[] values, rewrote the phases[].why text for the 5 rows that flipped so they argue for the new side, and added the Dark Passage shield note to Key Ability Interactions.
